def database():
    db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', isolation_level=None)
    db.executescript('CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT); INSERT INTO records VALUES(1,"alpha",NULL),(2,"beta",NULL),(3,"gamma",NULL);')

# The recorded checkpoint survives, but the data transaction rolls back.
db = database()
selected = db.execute('SELECT id, old_value FROM records WHERE id <= 2 ORDER BY id').fetchall()
checkpoint = selected[-1][0]
db.execute('BEGIN')
for key, value in selected:
    db.execute('UPDATE records SET new_value=? WHERE id=?', (value.upper(), key))
db.execute('ROLLBACK')
for key, value in db.execute('SELECT id,old_value FROM records WHERE id>? ORDER BY id', (checkpoint,)).fetchall():

    await asyncio.sleep(0.003)
